name: Javier Romo
headline: Trinity College junior studying Data Science. Open to internships, short collaborations, and hackathons.

projects.name: Disaster Response Pipeline
projects.what: A Java program built on my own data structures: a binary search tree, a hash map, a max-heap, and an undirected graph.

projects.name: Contacts App
projects.what: A Java contacts manager backed by my own BST-based map ADT.

projects.name: Lyrics Trainer
projects.what: A web page that helps you memorize a Shakespeare poem one line at a time, with next, previous, and jump-to-end buttons.

projects.name: OpenRouter Chat Client
projects.what: A single-file Java command-line client that sends a question to a model through OpenRouter and prints the answer with its token usage.

projects.name: Support Message Classifier
projects.what: A Java classifier that routes support messages into a strict JSON schema, with an eval harness of five cases including an ambiguous one and an off-topic one.

projects.name: Ask the Course
projects.what: A retrieval-augmented command-line tool that answers questions about the course from its Markdown pages, cites the file and section, and refuses when the pages do not contain the answer.

projects.name: Receipt reader
projects.what: A vision model reads a receipt photo into JSON and plain Python checks that the items and the total add up; it reports problems and never auto-corrects.

projects.name: Science diagram generator (Team Project 1)
projects.what: A web app where a student picks a science topic, an image model draws a labeled diagram, and a vision model critiques the image itself, with the verdict computed in code.

skills_shipped: OpenRouter chat, embeddings, vision, and image APIs
